method: Faithful float64 CPU reference of frozen native compositor allocation and presenter arithmetic, starting with exact actual570 consumer nativeCanvas RGBA. Premultiply once into RGBA8, guard16/alignment16, four quantized 2x2 area-mean mip levels; shader floor(log2(footprint)+1e-6), exact <=3x3 texel intersection weights, premultiplied background blending. Uniform common-root/camera fractions are removed from native-grid input and restored once in presentation. All objects retain their exact authored projections/relative roots. This isolates presenter arithmetic; it does not claim Godot GPU execution or cross-projection native scene RGB identity. Actual whole-canvas browser consumer evidence is separate.
